authority: MAP DESIGNS THE PHYSICAL WORLD. GAMEPLAY POPULATES AND SIMULATES IT.

transform.rule: Every coordinate in this export remains in Veyra authoring units. No rescale, crop, pad or warp to the 200x200 runtime island was performed. toCell() is the ONLY coordinate conversion used and it is a deterministic index lookup, not a world-scale decision.
transform.requiredDecision: An explicit, approved authoring-unit -> runtime-tile transform with measured journey times (t_foot, t_cart_loaded, exposure_time).

SOURCE_AUTHORED.statement: Veyra authors NO explicit road-to-road junction table. Junctions are geometric coincidences/intersections of control polylines. Explicit authored connectivity is limited to river mouth/source refs, bridge at/load, POI links and exact coincident endpoints.

maplabResampledGraphNodes.note: Idx over Catmull-Rom smoothed rivers+roads resampled at 8u, graph.ts order. At tol=8 the merge radius equals the 8u resample step, so consecutive samples collapse into one node and graph.ts addEdge(a,a) would DROP those road edges. This is not a harmless 1u difference.

geo01DerivedGraph.method: road endpoints + exact segment intersections, joinToleranceAu=8

geo01WalkableCandidateBFS.rule: walkableCandidate=1 OR (river centreline cell AND authored crossingCandidate>0)

foot.note: Dijkstra over 8-neighbour cells using analysis.ts stepMult (slope limit 1.5, biome multipliers, 9u road stroke DISCOUNT only — NOT a requirement). stepMult adds +80 (cart) / +50 (foot) on river cells but does NOT require a bridge. This is the EDITOR's own analysis heuristic and a RASTER CANDIDATE, NOT an authored road, NOT a Gameplay law and NOT a physically traversable cart route.

cart.note: Dijkstra over 8-neighbour cells using analysis.ts stepMult (slope limit 0.7, biome multipliers, 9u road stroke DISCOUNT only — NOT a requirement). stepMult adds +80 (cart) / +50 (foot) on river cells but does NOT require a bridge. This is the EDITOR's own analysis heuristic and a RASTER CANDIDATE, NOT an authored road, NOT a Gameplay law and NOT a physically traversable cart route.

RASTER_CANDIDATE.neverConflatedWithRoadGraph: The Dijkstra raster candidates are NOT the authored corridor: they take 0 river cells (no bridge at all), and roughly half their cells are outside even the 9u cart-road analysis raster. stepMult does not require a bridge or a road. The only authored cart bridge in this corridor is br_4 on rd_b, and no cart road reaches po_kilns within ACCESS_R=48. A connected raster candidate therefore proves NOTHING about a physically traversable cart route.

PHYSICAL_CLEARANCE.interpretation: Zero clearance is NOT a failure by itself: at br_4 the path must enter the river corridor. It means there is no free buffer around the centreline. With NO authored road width, river channel width, bridge deck span or cart footprint, swept clearance CANNOT be validated.

failingOrNeedsAuthoring.subject: RT-1 / RT-2 label "Authored cart corridor"
failingOrNeedsAuthoring.evidence: Only rd_b is kind:cart; rd_13, rd_1w, rd_16 are kind:trail. br_4 is a cart bridge but that does not make the route a cart route.
failingOrNeedsAuthoring.resolution: Re-label as a FOOT/TRAIL corridor with one cart segment. Do not claim cart traversability.

failingOrNeedsAuthoring.subject: po_kilns cart access
failingOrNeedsAuthoring.evidence: nearest cart road rd_n is 56.8792au away; editor ACCESS_R=48au.
failingOrNeedsAuthoring.resolution: No cart route to po_kilns is established. Either author a cart road (Map geometry, separate PROPOSED work) or keep the POI foot-access-only.

failingOrNeedsAuthoring.subject: GEO-01 derived connectors
failingOrNeedsAuthoring.evidence: 4 straight connectors (37.20au, 55.14au, 62.57au x2) are not authored roads; 2 exceed editor ACCESS_R=48.
failingOrNeedsAuthoring.resolution: Map must author centreline + surface + width before any of these becomes a physical path.

failingOrNeedsAuthoring.subject: Swept clearance at br_4
failingOrNeedsAuthoring.evidence: 1 zero-clearance cells on the GEO-01 BFS path; road width, river channel width, bridge deck span and cart footprint are all UNDEFINED.
failingOrNeedsAuthoring.resolution: Validate dimensions and swept clearance before any cart-route claim. channelSpanFitVerified remains false.

failingOrNeedsAuthoring.subject: Road junction tolerance
failingOrNeedsAuthoring.evidence: GEO-01 joinToleranceAu=8 vs editor SNAP_TOL=7; 4 endpoint joins exist only at 8; resampled graph nodes 1444 @7 vs 790 @8, with 773 consecutive-sample self-merges at 8 that would delete road edges in graph.ts.
failingOrNeedsAuthoring.resolution: Re-derive the road graph at SNAP_TOL=7 on Catmull-Rom smoothed curves.

failingOrNeedsAuthoring.subject: po_kilns physical shell
failingOrNeedsAuthoring.resolution: A PROPOSED, non-canonical Map-owned candidate is in output/poi_po_kilns.proposed.v1.json.

failingOrNeedsAuthoring.subject: Bridge span fit for both crossings
failingOrNeedsAuthoring.evidence: br_4 (cart) and br_a (foot) are covered by BRIDGE_R=22, but the 13x7.2u exporter rectangle is a display glyph, not a physical deck span. River mask stroke is max(width,9)u.
failingOrNeedsAuthoring.resolution: Author/approve physical channel width and deck span; do not infer span from the glyph.

failingOrNeedsAuthoring.subject: br_a / rd_20 crossing (RT-3)
failingOrNeedsAuthoring.evidence: bridge load=foot; rd_20 is kind:riverside. graph.ts blocks cart at any foot-load bridge.
failingOrNeedsAuthoring.resolution: RT-3 is a FOOT candidate only. Never present it as a cart alternative.

correctionsToGeo01: RT-1 is NOT an "Authored cart corridor": only rd_b is cart; the rest are trails.
joinToleranceAu=8 is not the editor tolerance (SNAP_TOL=7).
The 50-step BFS path is a RASTER CANDIDATE, not a physically traversable cart route.
Zero clearance is reported explicitly with au distances from MapLab masks, not hidden behind a mean.
Physical POI rooms/entrances/passages/door openings are MAP_OWNED, not Gameplay-owned.
